verdict.rationale: Solid's docs describe fine-grained reactivity in which only the code depending on changed state reruns. Components run once to set up the view, and a `<div>` is a real div with direct DOM access, which implies DOM updates without a diffing step. Community reports independently back this up: they describe Solid as realizing fine-grained reactive updates, cite dom-expressions, and report top benchmark speed. Missing for 10: an explicit first-party statement that there is no virtual DOM, and documentation of the compile-time JSX optimization (only the `jsx: preserve` config hints at a compiler step).
